name: Canalière Vogel
original_name: カナーリエ＝フォーゲル
source:
Job: Swordsman
Origin: Fleur Lapin Kingdom

A longsword-wielding swordsman belonging to the Adventurer's Guild.
She is qualified to investigate forbidden areas and is one of the most skilled members of the guild. She
has high mission completion abilities, but is also very curious and sometimes takes actions that other adventurers would never expect.
Her actions and fate can also show various possibilities depending on the observer.
A woman like a kaleidoscope.
She is very skilled in handling tools.
A lone wolf.
